llm_error.missing_config: Host / GLM is not configured. Enter the API key and model in Settings.
llm_error.unauthorized: Authentication failed. Check the API key in Settings.
llm_error.bad_request: The upstream service rejected the request. Try again later or check the configuration.
llm_error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again later.
llm_error.unavailable: The upstream service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
llm_error.timeout: The call timed out. Try again later.
llm_error.total_timeout: The response took too long and was stopped. Shorten the request or try again later.
llm_error.truncated: The reply was cut off. Try again or shorten the request.
llm_error.thinking_exhausted: The model spent its whole output budget on thinking and gave no reply. Shorten the request or try again later.
llm_error.content_filtered: The reply was blocked by the upstream safety review. Adjust the request and try again.
llm_error.inference_failed: The model hit an inference error. Try again later.
llm_error.context_exceeded: The conversation is longer than the model's context window. Shorten the request or start a new chat.
llm_error.unknown_finish: The model stopped for an unknown reason ({reason}) and gave no reply. Nothing was written.
llm_error.unsupported_tool_calls: The upstream service does not support tool calls (tool_calls), so the turn cannot continue.
llm_error.invalid_response: The model's response was malformed. Nothing was written.
turn.empty_reply_wrote: Writes were made, but the model gave no final reply.
turn.empty_reply_tools_only: Tools ran and nothing was written, but the model gave no final reply.
turn.empty_reply_nothing: The model's response was empty. Nothing was written.
turn.no_wrap_up: The LLM call limit for this turn was reached; nothing further was run.
turn.mcp_without_tools: The MCP service for this scene exposes no tools, so the turn cannot continue.
turn.mcp_unavailable: The MCP service for this scene is unavailable: {error}
turn.unusable_response: The model's response was malformed or asked for an unsupported tool. Nothing was written.
turn.clarify_limit: Too many clarifying questions. Rephrase the request or try again later.
turn.not_configured: GLM is not configured. Configure Host / GLM in Settings before starting a chat.
turn.unbound: Unbound — no active Binding Contract; chat cannot run.
turn.empty_prompt: Binding prompt is empty; cannot run chat.
turn.session_mismatch: Session identity mismatch — cut or stale session cannot continue.
